test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five men M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting in a row facing north. M is sitting at one end and O is on the other end. Q sits to the immediate left of M and to the immediate right of P. Who sits third to the right of O?
solution: Given: Five men M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting in a row facing north. 1) Q sits to the immediate left of M and to the immediate right of P. 2) M is sitting at one end and O is on the other end.
